description: ImpAI's damaged army mends (the `impai-mend` test group, tools/replay/fixtures.json; impai_mil.c, THE MEND; impai_build.c, THE REPAIR): Comet Catcher with fixed starts, true line of sight, mapped, at Hard, the level's end test off. Every unit of the level is cleared; seat 1 is ImpAI (CORE, StartPos2, so the launch writes `seatai=1`) with its commander at its start (5184, 640), a K-bot lab at (5440, 640), two construction K-bots (CORCK) beside them, and six army units at 30 % of their health -- two CORAK, two CORSTORM, two CORTHUD -- around (5184, 1500), between impai-fight.json's army (centred at (5184, 1100)) and the line its description gives for unmeasured ground (south of (5184, 1728)); the apply's result names any create the engine refuses. Seat 2 is OTA AI (ARM) with its commander and lab at (5184, 3000) and (5440, 3000) and no army; seat 0 is an idle human with no unit. Each computer seat's base storage is 1000 metal and 1000 energy, the applier's write after its clear. The six join one FORM squad and enter the mend in the first decisions, at most half the squad's value at once (the cap), so in waves; they walk to the rally point, are repaired by the constructors as those finish their builds (THE REPAIR takes idle builders before the ladder), are released at full health and join FORM again. With the end test off the group applies replay-objective-on.json as a step at its end, GameTime 5400, before replay-end.json's clear.
